verdict.rationale: Ramp's own case study claims AIRCO completed "full onboarding in 1 week vs. 6 months on prior platform" (ramp-docs-8), which matches the story almost word for word. Ramp also offers a Checking Account and treasury products, partner-prefilled applications, and turnkey ERP and bank integrations that would shorten setup. But the one-week claim rests on a single vendor testimonial about the overall Ramp platform, not banking specifically, with no documented onboarding timeline or process. Missing for 10: documented onboarding steps and typical time-to-live for Ramp banking, any independent or hands-on confirmation of a roughly one-week onboarding, and evidence that the timeline holds beyond one customer anecdote.
